note: Both sets capture the reference keynotes, scale, and the copper glycol-loop piping note, and both make the same questionable move of binding 22 33 00 and 23 56 01 to a generic 'Solar Thermal Distribution System' when those codes belong to the water tank and pump station. Set B additionally extracts well-supported title-block facts (design/construction/as-built submission dates, date, lot number, drawn by, checked by) that Set A omits entirely. However, Set B introduces one clearly misread claim ('23 56 13.0' instead of 23 56 13.01), while Set A's extra claims are mostly redundant duplicates of its own keynote entries. On balance B covers more of the page's real content with only one additional error.
